app.about.title: About
about.intro.creator: TempleOS was created by Terry A. Davis (1969-2018), who wrote its kernel, compiler, HolyC language, graphics, games and documentation, and dedicated it to the public domain.
about.intro.independent: This app is an independent mobile recreation of the TempleOS user environment. It is not an official TempleOS release, is not affiliated with Terry A. Davis or his estate, and does not boot the real TempleOS kernel or emulate a PC.
about.how.title: How it works
about.how.body: HolyC programs run on a sandboxed HolyC interpreter written for this app. The original TempleOS V5.03 graphics, sound, menu and math libraries, games, demos and documentation are included from the official TempleOS ISO and run on that interpreter; a few hot drawing routines run natively and are tested pixel for pixel against the originals. Some of the original wording, including slurs and derogatory remarks about groups of people, was censored or redacted by this project; these edits are not Terry A. Davis' wording. Including his work does not mean endorsing every statement in it.
about.additions.title: Original work and modern additions
about.additions.words: {app} is an unofficial mobile interpretation of TempleOS, originally created by Terry A. Davis. God Words is based on Terry A. Davis' original word-generation system: it picks entries from his English vocabulary (Adam/God/Vocab.DD) the way his GodWord function does, and that English vocabulary remains the reference. This mobile edition extends it with vocabulary localization: each picked entry can be shown in the app's language.
about.additions.modern: The multilingual vocabulary, the interface translations and the mobile adaptations are additions to this project and were not part of Terry A. Davis' original TempleOS. The vocabulary translations were machine-generated and may contain mistakes.
about.credits.title: Credits
about.credits.templeos: TempleOS V5.03, programs, games, documentation: Terry A. Davis (public domain).
about.credits.font: System font (Kernel/FontStd.HC): from FreeDOS, public domain (Doc/Credits.DD).
about.credits.kotlin: Android app: Kotlin standard library, Apache License 2.0.
about.credits.bible: Bible text (Misc/Bible.TXT): as distributed with TempleOS.
about.credits.templeos_web: TempleOS-Web by ParkerrDev was studied as a behavioral reference; no code from it is included.
about.credits.translations: Interface translations: machine-assisted; they may contain mistakes.
about.privacy.title: Privacy
about.privacy.body: Everything works offline. The app has no network access, no accounts, no analytics and no ads. Your files stay on this device.
